description.value: SoLo Suites is a modern condo-hotel in Langford on BC's Westshore, roughly 25 minutes from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Its 40 suites across six concrete-and-steel storeys each include a full kitchen and in-suite laundry, making it well-suited to multi-night touring stays. The property sits near outdoor recreation areas and provides easy access to both Westshore amenities and greater Victoria.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is operational (active booking system, 2026 copyright), matches the OSM name and phone number, and provides an address with a different postcode (V9B 2W7) than OSM (V9V 2W7). The website explicitly mentions in-suite laundry in every unit and OSM tags internet_access=wlan; no mention of bike storage, bike procedures, or most other cycling amenities is found anywhere in the fetched content.
